title: Theo and the Harvest
author: Mirabel Almeida
blurb: Paloma Dunmore, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
